name: token-guard
description: TokenGuard - Local AI Token Optimizer & Native Desktop App for PC and Mac

scripts.copy:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/src/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('src/public', 'dist/src/public', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('src/public', 'dist/public', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:electron && npm run copy:public
